text:
alex: Received a truck at EU-AMS dock, AWB 1Z9999. 10 H100 units. Manifest vs pallet scan mismatch: 2 serials not on manifest. photos in thread. Can vendor confirm if these are replacements or extras?
vendor-ops: Looking. AWB 1Z9999 - our side shows 10 units allocated. Do you have the 6-digit local pallet IDs? we got pallet IDs P-438, P-439
alex: Pallet scans: P-438 -> 6 H100s serials [H100-1001,H100-1002,H100-1003,H100-1004,H100-1005,H100-1006], P-439 -> 4 H100s [H100-2001,H100-2002,H100-2003,H100-2004]. Manifest lists H100-1001..1008, H100-2001..2002. So H100-1007 and H100-1008 missing from pallet 439, and H100-2003/2004 are extras.
maria: :eyes: Do we already have these extras assigned to other customers? This was a reserve pool shipment.
vendor-ops: Not assigned. Looks like a packing shuffle at the depot. We can do either: 1) Accept extras and process inventory reconciliation + credit; 2) Initiate RMA for the two missing manifest serials (likely at originating depot) and replace via air if needed. Option 2 costs vendor expedite fee. Which do you prefer?
raj: Cost and timeline? We need these for a Dedicated cluster going live Friday. Lead time matters.
vendor-ops: If we accept extras and reconcile, we can update allocation within 48h, cost neutral (we absorb audit). If we RMA back to origin and air replace, ETA 4 business days and there's an expedite surcharge ~€12k. Customs note: returning units may require export docs.
jonah: Also flag: two of the units on P-439 show firmware 02.11 while manifest expected 02.14. Can we avoid shipping units with older firmware to production? That causes validation failures.
vendor-ops: For firmware mismatches we suggest depot flash (+€350/unit) or swap for already-updated units. Depot flash adds 1 business day.
alex: Quick preference poll: for this rollout we need capacity; prefer accept extras + depot flash for the two older firmware units. Can you confirm insurance and liability on non-manifest units?
vendor-ops: Insurance: these units are covered under our transit policy. If we absorb reconciliation, we keep liability. If you consume extras, we'll update the PO and attach credit note. We'll issue an amendment to the contract. I'll start the paperwork.
maria: Also need serial audit sheet and AVS for cloud team. Can you post diff file? run: 
```
# quick diff
cat manifest.txt | sort > m.txt
cat pallet_scan.txt | sort > p.txt
comm -23 m.txt p.txt > missing.txt
comm -13 m.txt p.txt > extras.txt
```
vendor-ops: Uploaded missing.txt and extras.txt to the ticket: https://vendor-portal/track/VT-8421
nexus-broker-bot: Incident auto-note: Created RMA VT-8421; status=investigating
raj: Any customs hold risk if we keep extras and don't return? need invoice amendment by EOD to avoid hold.
vendor-ops: Will push credit note and amended commercial invoice by EOD CET. If customs requests return authorizations we'll coordinate.
alex: OK let's proceed: accept extras, depot flash the two firmware units, vendor to issue credit note + amended invoice by EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup: 
vendor-ops: Roger. Starting workstream. I'll DM for secure photos and initiate depot flash order.
jonah: tagging infra leads: @mike @sarah - heads up impacted rack 7 scheduling. 
alex: I'll coordinate rack freeze window. End.
